normalization_rule: Retry-After is admissible only when it parses to a finite nonnegative delay. Missing, malformed, negative, or non-finite values do not get sampled repeatedly; use the deterministic capped-exponential fallback once and persist the selected delay.

decision_rules.RETRY_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: If retry_attempt >= max_attempts, do not retry. If an alternative plan exists, SWITCH_PLAN; otherwise DEFER_NO_ALTERNATIVE. This hard count boundary has precedence over simultaneous forecast overrun for stable cause labeling.
decision_rules.FORECAST_OVERRUN: If retry budget remains but persisted_wait_seconds + forecast_p90_remaining_seconds + retry_reserve_seconds > budget_remaining_seconds, do not retry. If an alternative plan exists, SWITCH_PLAN; otherwise DEFER_NO_ALTERNATIVE.
decision_rules.RATE_LIMIT_WAIT: If retry budget remains and the budget test passes but current time is before persisted not_before, DEFER_RATE_LIMIT without resampling delay.
decision_rules.RETRY_ELIGIBLE: Only if retry budget remains, the budget test passes, and not_before is satisfied may at most one next retry observation be authorized.

monotonicity_rule: A plan switch increments plan_generation exactly once; replaying the same cause cannot decrement generation or increment switch_count again.
no_handoff_rule: DEFER_NO_ALTERNATIVE is a durable unresolved state, not a request for richer-mode/Work/protected-primary/manual-user execution.
quota_zero_assessment: Repository text-state policy only; no hosted runner, Codespaces, artifact/LFS/package, cloud/model credit, protected-primary merge, or manual execution step.
